name: Honeypot
author: Bluscream (bluscream_)
short: Trap channels that softban/ban spam bots and hacked accounts the moment they post.
description: Modelled on RiskyMH's Honeypot bot: multiple text/voice trap channels, softban (default), ban or disabled, recovery DM with optional rejoin invite, per-channel counters in the warning, log channel with unban button, Red modlog cases, owner/admin exemption, and experiments (forward message, reinvite, no warning, no DM, channel warmer, daily random/chaos rename, daily recreate, timeout first, only recent delete, ensure message delete).
install_msg: Thanks for installing Honeypot! Run `[p]honeypot create` (or `[p]honeypot add #channel`), `[p]honeypot logchannel #mod-log`, then `[p]honeypot status` to check permissions.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no per-user data. It keeps per-server settings, honeypot channel IDs with action counters, and one invite code. Triggering users are only named in the server's own log channel.
